description: Combine the tile-major n=512 sidecar plus direct-FP32 n=2048 global-best stack with the fused-WMMA exact batch-160 n=128 winner. Import only the n=128 operator, its launch binding, shape-scoped output/cache state, and required compilation flags; preserve every n=256/n=512/n=1024/n=2048 and large dispatch, caller-stream behavior, cache resets, repeated outputs, fresh inputs, policy checks, and the full grid.

Integrated the exact fused 16-wide compensated-TF32 WMMA n=128 operator into the tile-major n=512 and direct-FP32 n=2048 parent, retaining its shape-scoped extension output cache and switching its launch to the caller-current stream. Build, kernelguard, banned-stream gate, all 17 official tests, fresh-input guard, and the full 15-cell grid passed. n=128 measured 59.049 us; aggregate measured 923.470 us versus the 912.313 us first parent.

Removed the entry and exit warp synchronizations from the fused n=128 16x16 factor helper because every initial call is dominated by the post-staging CTA barrier and every final call feeds directly into a CTA barrier. Full build, static policy checks, 17 official tests, fresh-input guard, and all 15 benchmark cells passed. n=128 improved from 59.049 to 58.169 us; aggregate remeasured at 912.613 us versus 923.470 for exact integration and 912.313 for the first parent.

Skipped global input and shared output reads for n=128 float4 vectors wholly above the diagonal, while explicitly writing zeros and retaining lane masks on the one boundary vector per row. Build, kernelguard, banned-stream gate, all official tests, fresh-input guard, and full grid passed. n=128 improved from 58.169 to 57.260 us; aggregate measured 918.965 us, with unrelated n=512/n=2048 cells sampling slower than the 912.613 prior trial.

Changed newly cached n=128 outputs to zero initialization, then omitted wholly upper-triangle shared staging and global output stores on repeated launches while preserving masked diagonal-boundary float4 writes. Build, static policy gates, all official tests, fresh-input guard, and every benchmark cell passed. n=128 improved from 57.260 to 56.045 us; aggregate reached 909.588 us versus 912.313 for the first parent.

Reassigned n=128 triangular float4 staging to half-warp row teams that enumerate only 2,080 live vectors rather than branch across all 4,096 vectors. Full build, policy gates, official tests, fresh-input guard, and benchmark grid passed, but half-warp coalescing and row-loop overhead raised n=128 from 56.045 to 57.996 us; aggregate measured 912.246 us.

Mapped n=128 triangular staging to one full warp per row, preserving coalesced row transactions while eliminating upper-vector work and division/modulo indexing. All mandatory gates and cells passed, but low-lane utilization on early rows raised n=128 from 56.045 to 59.116 us, behind the half-warp schedule at 57.996; aggregate measured 915.958 us.

Integrated the fused compensated-TF32 WMMA n=128 operator into the tile-major n=512/direct-FP32 n=2048 stack and measured six valid committed trials. Exact integration was 59.049 us target/923.470 aggregate; removing redundant warp barriers reached 58.169/912.613; skipping upper reads reached 57.260/918.965; best c213c7a0ab26ce17de1b9c3d3fd98e4bb86af350 cached zeroed n=128 outputs and omitted upper shared/global stores, reaching 56.045 us and 909.588 us versus the 912.313 first parent. Half-warp and full-warp compact triangular staging remained correct but measured 57.996 and 59.116 us. Every trial passed build, policy gates, 17 official tests, fresh-input guards, and the full 15-cell grid; local profiling was waived. Keep this line moving with complementary-triangle two-matrix shared packing, a cache-initialization kernel that zeros only upper vectors instead of full zeros_like, or asynchronous lower-triangle staging while retaining c213c7a's coalesced linear schedule.
